message: I have this friend who turns every storm warning into a full-blown crisis. Last week, she called me in a tizzy about a winter storm that was still days away. I told her to relax, grab some hot cocoa, and maybe even watch a movie. Turns out, she just needed a little calm in the chaos. Sometimes, a cozy night in is the best prep there is. How do you stay calm when the weather gets a little wild?
